Reflection

Your personality

Ten statements to reflect on the five broad personality dimensions studied by trait psychology.

This is a reflection activity using our own statements, not a validated test. There are no right or wrong answers, and no result is better than another: each end has advantages depending on the situation.

1. I like trying activities or foods I don't know.

2. I prefer to keep doing things the way I always have.

3. I usually finish tasks before the deadline.

4. I often leave things half done.

5. I enjoy meeting new people at a party.

6. After a long time with people I need to be alone.

7. I easily put myself in other people's shoes.

8. I find it hard to give ground in an argument.

9. I worry about things that may never happen.

10. I calm down quickly after being upset.

To study personality with documented instruments, psychology uses trait-based questionnaires and the five-factor model. The IPIP bank offers public-domain items; even so, a translation or short form needs its own validation.
